notes: Site: Shopify store behind Cloudflare managed challenge; accessed via curl_cffi Chrome-124 TLS impersonation hitting Shopify JSON side-doors, same route verified in prior Home-Decor pass. Enumerated ALL 201 published collections via collections.json pagination and scanned every handle/title for clearance-type terms (clear, outlet, final, last-chance, end-of, discontinu, sale, markdown, discount, offer, deal, reduced) - zero matches of any kind; the full sorted collection list contains no Clearance/Outlet/Sale/Offers/Discount/Deals collection under any name. Checked main nav and homepage HTML for any Clearance/Sale/Outlet link or section - none found (only price-tier browse collections exist, e.g. 'Below Rs. 500', 'gifts-under-rs-1000/2500/5000', which are generic price-filter pages, not clearance/outlet merchandising, and were not counted). Checked the site's own predictive search (search/suggest.json) for 'clearance', 'outlet', 'sale', and 'final sale' - all returned zero matching collections and zero matching pages (the few product hits under 'outlet'/'sale' were fuzzy/incidental body-text matches on unrelated products - a wristlet and a singing bowl - not clearance-tagged or outlet-merchandised items). This is treated as genuine absence, not a default-search artifact, per the site-search-false-absence-test convention: absence was confirmed via the exhaustive collections.json enumeration (the authoritative source of every published Shopify collection on this store) plus nav plus search, not search alone.
